workload_rule: Maintain explicitly confirmed current weekly running seconds. Divide into three sessions, distributing integer remainder seconds in A/B/C order. Each running block must fit explicitly confirmed current continuous capacity. Historical longest sessions never enter this calculation.
evidence_required: explicit confirmation of both current facts
limitations: Original candidate arithmetic, not evidence of individual safety
Added walking load requires coaching review
No advancement, return-to-running, first-time, taper or event-readiness rule
Only one week; no promise that a fixed race date is achievable
review_decisions: Approve, modify or reject equal allocation
Review walking duration and total load
Review entry criteria, frequency and recovery
